title: Port lock and login screens to Kirigami.Avatar
line: Users without a picture now get their initials on the lock and login screens, as in System Settings, instead of a generic face.
explanation: The shared user delegate of the lock and login screens drew its own Image plus a Kirigami.Icon fallback, clipped round by a custom shader, so users without a picture got the generic user icon. On the login screen SDDM also hands those users the theme's default face file, so even a fallback to initials would never trigger there. The delegate now shows a Kirigami Addons Avatar with initials when there is no picture and cuts real pictures round with Kirigami.ShadowedTexture (the custom shader is gone); UserList gains a placeholderIcon property, which the SDDM Breeze theme sets to its default face so it counts as no picture.

commits.message:
lookandfeel: Show initials for users without a picture

Lock and login screens showed a generic icon for users with no picture.
Show Avatar initials like System Settings, cut pictures round with
ShadowedTexture, not a shader, and let themes name a placeholder face.

BUG: 437418

sddm-theme: Show initials for users without their own picture

SDDM gives users without a picture of their own the theme's default face, so
the login screen showed that generic face where System Settings shows their
initials. Tell the user list it is a placeholder, so they get initials.

BUG: 437418

patches.diff:
From f9bc801963376de8a58365161fa9e0fc226b3cbd Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:58:37 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] sddm-theme: Show initials for users without their own picture

SDDM gives users without a picture of their own the theme's default face, so
the login screen showed that generic face where System Settings shows their
initials. Tell the user list it is a placeholder, so they get initials.

BUG: 437418
---
 sddm-theme/Main.qml | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/sddm-theme/Main.qml b/sddm-theme/Main.qml
index 3379ead93e..dddc652f76 100644
--- a/sddm-theme/Main.qml
+++ b/sddm-theme/Main.qml
@@ -175,6 +175,8 @@ Item {
             initialItem: Login {
                 id: userListComponent
                 userListModel: userModel
+                // SDDM gives this face to users without a picture: show their initials instead
+                userList.placeholderIcon: Qt.resolvedUrl("faces/.face.icon")
                 loginScreenUiVisible: loginScreenRoot.uiVisible
                 userListCurrentIndex: userModel.lastIndex >= 0 ? userModel.lastIndex : 0
                 lastUserName: userModel.lastUser
-- 
2.53.0

From 00b84b01418b96624865b5eca90a7f4ca8f7fd2f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:58:37 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] lookandfeel: Show initials for users without a picture

Lock and login screens showed a generic icon for users with no picture.
Show Avatar initials like System Settings, cut pictures round with
ShadowedTexture, not a shader, and let themes name a placeholder face.

BUG: 437418
---
 lookandfeel/CMakeLists.txt               |  2 -
 lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.frag | 51 ----------------
 lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.qml  | 77 ++++++++++--------------
 lookandfeel/components/UserList.qml      |  8 ++-
 4 files changed, 39 insertions(+), 99 deletions(-)
 delete mode 100644 lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.frag

diff --git a/lookandfeel/CMakeLists.txt b/lookandfeel/CMakeLists.txt
index 822004bb18..7a05c34937 100644
--- a/lookandfeel/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/lookandfeel/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -24,9 +24,7 @@ qt6_add_shaders(components LNFSHADERS
     OPTIMIZED
     PREFIX "/qt/qml/org/kde/breeze/components/shaders/"
     FILES
-        components/UserDelegate.frag
         components/WallpaperFader.frag
     OUTPUTS
-        UserDelegate.frag.qsb
         WallpaperFader.frag.qsb
 )
diff --git a/lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.frag b/lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.frag
deleted file mode 100644
index a912e2eca7..0000000000
--- a/lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.frag
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,51 +0,0 @@
-/*
-    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2014 David Edmundson <davidedmundson@kde.org>
-    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2014 Aleix Pol Gonzalez <aleixpol@blue-systems.com>
-    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2023 David Redondo <kde@david-redondo.de>
-
-    SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.0-or-later
-*/
-//draw a circle with an antialiased border
-//innerRadius = size of the inner circle with contents
-//outerRadius = size of the border
-//blend = area to blend between two colours
-//all sizes are normalised so 0.5 == half the width of the texture
-
-//if copying into another project don't forget to connect themeChanged to update()
-//but in SDDM that's a bit pointless
-
-#version 440
-layout(location = 0) in vec2 qt_TexCoord0;
-layout(std140, binding = 0) uniform buf {
-    mat4 qt_Matrix;
-    float qt_Opacity;
-    vec4 colorBorder;
-};
-layout(binding = 1) uniform sampler2D source;
-layout(location = 0) out vec4 fragColor;
-
-
-const highp float blend = 0.01;
-const highp float innerRadius = 0.47;
-const highp float outerRadius = 0.49;
-const lowp vec4 colorEmpty = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
-
-void main() {
-    lowp vec4 colorSource = texture(source, qt_TexCoord0);
-
-    highp vec2 m = qt_TexCoord0 - vec2(0.5, 0.5);
-    highp float dist = sqrt(m.x * m.x + m.y * m.y);
-
-    if (dist < innerRadius)
-        fragColor = colorSource;
-    else if (dist < innerRadius + blend)
-        fragColor = mix(colorSource, colorBorder, ((dist - innerRadius) / blend));
-    else if (dist < outerRadius)
-        fragColor = colorBorder;
-    else if (dist < outerRadius + blend)
-        fragColor = mix(colorBorder, colorEmpty, ((dist - outerRadius) / blend));
-    else
-        fragColor = colorEmpty;
-
-    fragColor = fragColor * qt_Opacity;
-}
diff --git a/lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.qml b/lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.qml
index 0f2d8d9c6e..9d9cdba981 100644
--- a/lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.qml
+++ b/lookandfeel/components/UserDelegate.qml
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@ import QtQuick.Window
 
 import org.kde.plasma.components as PlasmaComponents3
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+import org.kde.kirigamiaddons.components as KirigamiComponents
 
 Item {
     id: wrapper
@@ -41,19 +42,9 @@ Item {
         }
     }
 
-    // Draw a translucent background circle under the user picture
-    Rectangle {
-        anchors.centerIn: imageSource
-        width: imageSource.width - 2 // Subtract to prevent fringing
-        height: width
-        radius: width / 2
-
-        color: Kirigami.Theme.backgroundColor
-        opacity: 0.6
-    }
-
-    Item {
-        id: imageSource
+    // Without a picture, show the same initials as System Settings
+    KirigamiComponents.Avatar {
+        id: avatar
         anchors.top: parent.top
         anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
 
@@ -66,48 +57,44 @@ Item {
         width: wrapper.isCurrent ? wrapper.faceSize : wrapper.faceSize - Kirigami.Units.gridUnit
         height: width
 
-        //Image takes priority, taking a full path to a file, if that doesn't exist we show an icon
-        Image {
-            id: face
-            source: wrapper.avatarPath
-            sourceSize: Qt.size(wrapper.faceSize * Screen.devicePixelRatio, wrapper.faceSize * Screen.devicePixelRatio)
-            fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
-            anchors.fill: parent
-        }
-
-        Kirigami.Icon {
-            id: faceIcon
-            source: wrapper.iconSource
-            visible: face.status === Image.Error || face.status === Image.Null
-            anchors.fill: parent
-        }
+        name: wrapper.name
+        iconSource: wrapper.iconSource
+        imageMode: KirigamiComponents.Avatar.ImageMode.AlwaysShowInitials
+        visible: face.status !== Image.Ready
     }
 
-    ShaderEffect {
-        anchors.top: parent.top
-        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
-
-        width: imageSource.width
-        height: imageSource.height
+    Image {
+        id: face
+        anchors.fill: avatar
+        source: wrapper.avatarPath
+        sourceSize: Qt.size(wrapper.faceSize * Screen.devicePixelRatio, wrapper.faceSize * Screen.devicePixelRatio)
+        fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
+        mipmap: true
+    }
 
-        supportsAtlasTextures: true
+    // Cut the picture round with a border. Unlike Avatar, ShadowedTexture also
+    // does that with software rendering.
+    Kirigami.ShadowedTexture {
+        anchors.fill: avatar
+        visible: face.status === Image.Ready
 
-        readonly property Item source: ShaderEffectSource {
-            sourceItem: imageSource
-            // software rendering is just a fallback so we can accept not having a rounded avatar here
-            hideSource: wrapper.GraphicsInfo.api !== GraphicsInfo.Software
-            live: true // otherwise the user in focus will show a blurred avatar
+        radius: width / 2
+        color: Kirigami.Theme.backgroundColor
+        border.width: Math.round(width / 50)
+        border.color: Kirigami.Theme.textColor
+
+        source: ShaderEffectSource {
+            sourceItem: face
+            hideSource: true
+            // The software renderer draws the texture as it is: don't flip it as for OpenGL
+            textureMirroring: wrapper.softwareRendering ? ShaderEffectSource.NoMirroring : ShaderEffectSource.MirrorVertically
         }
-
-        readonly property color colorBorder: Kirigami.Theme.textColor
-
-        fragmentShader: "qrc:/qt/qml/org/kde/breeze/components/shaders/UserDelegate.frag.qsb"
     }
 
     PlasmaComponents3.Label {
         id: usernameDelegate
 
-        anchors.top: imageSource.bottom
+        anchors.top: avatar.bottom
         anchors.topMargin: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit
         anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
 
diff --git a/lookandfeel/components/UserList.qml b/lookandfeel/components/UserList.qml
index 64f51da18d..30a22f9bc7 100644
--- a/lookandfeel/components/UserList.qml
+++ b/lookandfeel/components/UserList.qml
@@ -35,6 +35,12 @@ ListView {
     readonly property bool constrainText: count > 1
     property real fontSize: Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pointSize + 2
 
+    /*
+     * The picture the model gives users who have none of their own, such as
+     * the SDDM theme's default face. Those users get initials instead.
+     */
+    property url placeholderIcon
+
     implicitHeight: userItemHeight
 
     activeFocusOnTab: true
@@ -60,7 +66,7 @@ ListView {
         required property string icon
         required property string realName
         required property var model
-        avatarPath: icon || ""
+        avatarPath: icon && icon !== view.placeholderIcon.toString() ? icon : ""
         iconSource: model.iconName || "user-identity"
         fontSize: view.fontSize
         needsPassword: model.needsPassword !== undefined ? model.needsPassword : true
--
